name: Alluvial
characteristics: Fertile, loamy, river-deposited; N/P low to medium, K high

name: Black (Regur)
characteristics: Clayey, moisture-retentive, cracks on drying; high Ca/Mg, low N/P

name: Laterite
characteristics: Highly weathered, acidic, low fertility, high Fe/Al

name: Desert
characteristics: Sandy, low organic matter, low water holding

name: Saline & Alkaline
characteristics: High salts / high pH, poor structure, low infiltration
crops: Reclaim with gypsum; tolerant crops (barley, date palm)

name: Forest & Mountain
characteristics: Variable, often acidic, high organic matter in upper layer
